items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與 3.8 Flash Cyber
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.8 Flash as its most intelligent workhorse model, claiming gains over 3.7 Flash on long-horizon software engineering, agentic tasks, and multi-step reasoning, at the same introductory price of $0.75/$3.75 per million input/output tokens. A restricted sibling, 3.8 Flash Cyber, is offered to trusted defenders through the new Fairwind Program for vulnerability discovery and automated patching. Hassabis called it another Flash upgrade in under a month.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 為目前最聰明的工作馬模型，稱在長程軟體工程、代理任務與多步推理上優於 3.7 Flash，導入價維持每百萬 token $0.75／$3.75。受限版 3.8 Flash Cyber 經新設 Fairwind Program 提供給受信任防禦方，用於漏洞發現與自動修補。Hassabis 稱這是一個月內又一次 Flash 升級。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cadence-and-cost strategy is the point: Google is iterating Flash faster than flagship Pro drops, and pairing a public workhorse with a restricted cyber variant. Independent confirmation of DeepSWE, CyberGym, and Chrome-patch claims is still pending; introductory pricing expires 31 Dec 2026.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 節奏與成本才是重點：Google 用 Flash 連發補上旗艦 Pro 空窗，並把公開工作馬與受限資安變體拆開。DeepSWE、CyberGym 與 Chrome 修補數據仍待獨立覆核；導入價於 2026-12-31 到期。
items_flat.quote: today we’re introducing Gemini 3.8, our best reasoning & coding model yet, at the same speed and low cost of 3.7.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini 3.8，目前最佳推理與程式模型，速度與成本與 3.7 相同。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.3 in Muse Code and Meta Model API
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Spark 1.3，上線 Muse Code 與 Model API
items_flat.summary_en: Meta AI released Muse Spark 1.3, saying it improves agentic and coding work, sustains longer multi-workflow threads, and uses about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens than 1.2 in internal comparisons. It is live in Muse Code and the Meta Model API; max reasoning is held until extra safety testing finishes. The lab also said bigger models and Muse Spark open weights are coming.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta AI 發布 Muse Spark 1.3，稱在代理與程式任務上有提升，能在單一長執行緒同時處理多工作流；內部對比稱工具呼叫約少 20%、token 約少 25%。現已上線 Muse Code 與 Meta Model API；max reasoning 待額外安全測試後推出。實驗室並預告更大模型與 Muse Spark 開源權重。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a mid-cycle usability and efficiency update, not a new family. Third-party scores (e.g. Artificial Analysis) put some 1.3 settings near Sol/Grok 4.6, but max reasoning is not generally available yet, so headline comparisons remain incomplete.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是週期中的可用性與效率更新，不是新系列。第三方評測把部分 1.3 設定拉近 Sol／Grok 4.6，但 max reasoning 尚未全面開放，頭條對比仍不完整。
items_flat.quote: We’re excited to release Muse Spark 1.3, which delivers improved performance across agentic and coding tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們很高興發布 Muse Spark 1.3，在代理與程式任務上帶來更好表現。

items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克：Grok 4.7 將於 10 天後推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that Grok 4.7 “comes out in 10 days,” implying a target around September 12, after Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke praised Grok 4.6. He did not publish a lab blog, system card, or benchmarks with the post. Press recaps of earlier Musk comments cite a larger 2.1T base and SpaceX supplemental training; those details are not in the dated teaser itself.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 Grok 4.7「10 天後推出」，對應約 9 月 12 日，時值 Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke 稱讚 Grok 4.6。貼文未附實驗室部落格、系統卡或基準。媒體轉述他先前提到 2.1T 基座與 SpaceX 補充訓練，但那些細節不在這則定期預告本身。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a dated teaser, not a release. Whether 4.7 actually lands on that day, and how it compares with Gemini 3.8 Flash or Claude Fable 5.1, remains unverified until official evals and product access exist.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是定期預告，不是發表。能否準時落地、相對 Gemini 3.8 Flash 或 Claude Fable 5.1 如何，須等到官方評測與產品通路才能驗證。
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 將於 10 天後推出

items_flat.title_en: Claude can use a Mac in the background in Cowork and Claude Code
items_flat.title_zh: Claude 可在 Cowork 與 Claude Code 背景操作 Mac
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s @claudeai account said Claude can now use a computer in the background inside Claude Cowork and Claude Code: it clicks, types, and opens apps while the user works on something else. The feature is in beta on Pro and Max plans in the macOS desktop app; computer use is toggled in Settings. A help article covers how it works and how to use it safely.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 的 @claudeai 表示，Claude 現可在 Claude Cowork 與 Claude Code 背景使用電腦：在使用者做其他事時點擊、打字、開應用。功能為 Pro／Max 方案 beta，限 macOS 桌面 App，需在設定開啟。說明文件涵蓋用法與安全注意事項。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-surface expansion of computer use, not a new model. The practical change is unattended desktop agency on a Mac; reliability, permission scope, and misuse risk are the open questions, not raw model scores.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是電腦使用能力的產品面擴張，不是新模型。實際變化是 Mac 上可無人值守的桌面代理；未解問題是可靠度、權限範圍與濫用風險，而非模型分數。
items_flat.quote: Claude can now use your computer in the background in Claude Cowork and Claude Code.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 現在可以在 Claude Cowork 與 Claude Code 背景使用你的電腦。

items_flat.summary_en: The Grok Bot account posted that Grok Bot is now available on Android. Elon Musk quoted the post with “Grok @Bot now on Android!” The product is framed as persistent cloud teammates that keep the same bots and threads as desktop and iOS after the phone is locked.
items_flat.summary_zh: Grok Bot 帳號宣布現已登陸 Android。Elon Musk 轉貼並寫「Grok @Bot now on Android!」。產品定位為持續運作的雲端隊友，鎖屏後仍與桌面／iOS 共用同一批 Bot 與對話串。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a client rollout for an existing agent product, not a new foundation model. It widens where persistent Grok agents can run; capability claims still rest on the prior Bot stack and plan eligibility.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有代理產品的客戶端上架，不是新基礎模型。擴大了常駐 Grok agent 可運行的裝置；能力主張仍取決於既有 Bot 堆疊與方案資格。

Anthropic enabled background Mac computer use in Cowork/Claude Code. xAI put Grok Bot on Android; Musk still dates Grok 4.7 about 10 days out. No new OpenAI model drop in-window.
brief_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.8 Flash 與受限的 Flash Cyber（Fairwind）。Meta 釋出 Muse Spark 1.3。Anthropic 讓 Claude 可在 Mac 背景操作電腦。xAI 的 Grok Bot 上 Android；馬斯克仍稱 Grok 4.7 約 10 天後推出。視窗內無新的 OpenAI 模型發表。
